findings.title: Per-line grid opacity checks both axes instead of the line's own axis
findings.body:
**What goes wrong:** `grid_alpha` uses 0.4 alpha for a line with its own color only when neither axis has a `GridLinesStyle`. Now that the style is stored per axis, setting it for one axis also changes the lines of the other axis.

**Trigger:** `GridLinesStyle -> {Directive[Black], None}` with `GridLines -> {{1}, {{2, Blue}}}`. The x style is set, so the y line `{2, Blue}` is drawn fully opaque. The y axis has no style of its own, so it should get the default 0.4 alpha, as it did before this change.

**Fix:** pass the axis style into the closure and check only that one. Use `.1` when drawing the y lines and `.0` when drawing the x lines.
